hints.content: We have two tapes that are the same length. Let's start by writing an expression for the length of each tape.

The top tape has $6$ parts, each with a length of $p$ units.

The total length of the top tape is $p+p+p+p+p+p$ units, which we can simplify to $6p$ units.

The bottom tape has a length of $36$ units.

So, the tape diagram shows us $6p=36$.

The section labeled $p$ is $\dfrac{1}{6}$ the length of the $36$ unit long tape.

$p=\dfrac{36}{6}={}?$
